judgment_requirements: Every dimension has a response quote or explicit scoped omission, reasoning, and applicability.
Credit defensible solutions outside checklists; do not score keyword matches.
Evaluator labels each read attempt relevant, irrelevant or uncertain with a reason; no automatic path-based relevance. Denials can be uncertain.
Record dimension vector, no weighted sum or universal winner.

Fabricated outcomes, assumed missing hard semantics, unqualified deployment or omitted critical limitations fail the quality gate even if retrieval is small. Each failure requires a concrete quote or omission and affected dimensions.
Quality gate: every dimension at least 2, no critical failure; inconclusive stays inconclusive. Missing evidence cannot pass by zero cost.
Do not infer independent evaluator identity from role/model self-report; require external operator attestation and bound raw evidence.

scale.2: project-specific and defensible with important limits
scale.3: well-supported, discriminating and actionable within authority
